# Design Checklist: Gate de Conformidade Entidade–Contrato (replan)

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade, clareza, consistência e completude do **plano/design** (plan.md + research.md + data-model.md + contracts/), agora que `plan.md` existe.
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [plan.md](../plan.md) · [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Escopo desta execução**: passada ampla com contexto de plano (antes do `/speckit.tasks`). Complementa `conformance.md` (52 itens de requisitos), sem repeti-los.

## Design Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the plan specify how the generated test resolves the entity class (FQN) and the nested/enum types at runtime? [Completeness, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the normalized contract view used by the round-trip fully defined (Java names, `id` → `<entidade>Id`)? [Completeness, Plan §R12, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the plan enumerate every added/modified file, including runner wiring and the 21 absence assertions? [Completeness, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the guard's decision input (existence of `contract.json` vs. flag string) and its log output specified? [Completeness, Plan §R8, Spec §FR-002]

## Design Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the responsibility of each of the 6 test classes and 2 support classes stated unambiguously? [Clarity, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it clear how divergences from multiple classes are consolidated into the single entry-point failure (and its ordering)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Plan §data-model]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the surefire-report assertion defined precisely (which file name matches, which counters must be zero)? [Clarity, Plan §R5]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the scaffolding exception (`username`/`password`) defined with a clear trigger (empty effective attribute set) and a clear boundary? [Clarity, Plan §D12]

## Design Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are the plan deviations (D9–D12) each traceable to a spec gap or a technical impossibility, without contradicting a spec FR? [Consistency, Plan §Desvios]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the "zero new dependencies" constraint consistent with using Jackson (transitive) for both round-trip and reflection? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the sabotage proof consistent with the premise "o archetype nunca interpreta contrato/entidade"? [Consistency, Plan §R6]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the guard behavior consistent between spec FR-001/FR-002 and research R8 (contract existence vs. flag string)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Plan §R8]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Are the technical acceptance criteria (22 fixtures green, surefire green, sabotage failure, absence, pom diff) measurable and unambiguous? [Acceptance Criteria, Plan]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "zero new dependencies" verifiable through a concrete artifact comparison (pom diff)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario & Edge Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are all activation/removal combinations covered (flag true + contract; flag true + no contract; flag false; path `none`/`null`/empty/missing)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK016 Are Lombok on/off, empty contract, absent `id`, deep nesting, enum mismatch, and case-only differences each mapped to a test class or edge case? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the recovery path (fix drift → green again) specified anywhere in the plan? [Coverage, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK018 Is the dependence on the Surefire report format (3.2.5) documented as an assumption with a fallback if the report format changes? [Assumption, Plan §R5]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the assumption that the Maven wrapper exists in the generated project (fileset-08) validated for the sabotage step? [Assumption, Plan §R6]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK020 Is the A13 discrepancy (22 fixtures vs. the "15" in the spec) flagged with a clear owner and resolution step? [Conflict, Plan §A13]
- [ ] CHK021 Is it specified whether the enriched `entity-contract` contract (D11) requires updating the spec wording of SC-004/FR-015? [Ambiguity, Plan §D11]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- This checklist is design-focused and complements `conformance.md`; items do not overlap intentionally
- CHK017, CHK018, CHK019, CHK020, CHK021 are the prime candidates for a follow-up `/speckit.clarify` or a spec edit before `/speckit.tasks`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
